candidate_starts.reason: matches the prospectively generated source-QA mask timeline without using mask values or object outcomes
candidate_starts.stop: last start whose complete 81-frame window exists

prospective_window_rule.closure_confidence: per gripper, clip((episode aperture p90 - aperture)/(episode aperture p90 - episode aperture p10), 0, 1); smaller released aperture means more closed
prospective_window_rule.controller_centre: arithmetic mean of the five released action points per gripper
prospective_window_rule.gripper_aggregation: mean of per-gripper closure-weighted path lengths; gripper vectors are never averaged before taking their norms
prospective_window_rule.rule: maximize mean gripper-centre path weighted at each step by the minimum endpoint closure confidence
prospective_window_rule.static_aperture_fallback: confidence one, reducing exactly to unweighted path when aperture cannot identify closure
prospective_window_rule.step_weight: minimum closure confidence at the two endpoints of each gripper-centre path step
